distribution.compatibilityNotes: Public test prerelease; not a stable release. Offline Dynasty only. AIO 1.4.1 + TeamBuilder patch has targeted adapters; exact game/overhaul combinations still require live acceptance. Keep a backup and an older installer. Updates are optional.
